_note: Fill in all fields after a successful end-to-end lab run. Do not claim V1 until all required sections are true. LDAP state verification does not prove Kerberos ticket issuance.

environment_mapping.ldap_signing_notes: Mark unknown unless actively probed. Do not set false without a negative probe result.

acl_prediction_validation.createchild_grant_detected_notes: Create test OU, grant CreateChild:dMSA to test principal, verify map detects it.
acl_prediction_validation.createchild_revoke_notes: Remove grant, re-run map, verify path no longer appears.
acl_prediction_validation.deny_ace_notes: Add DENY CreateChild before allow, verify map does not claim the right.
acl_prediction_validation.nested_group_notes: Grant via nested group membership, verify map detects effective right.
acl_prediction_validation.owner_writedacl_notes: Owner-only WriteDACL must be classified as dacl-* indirect path, not direct primitive.

postpatch_mutual_pair_flow.ldap_verify_notes: LDAP-state verification confirms attribute values. It does NOT prove Kerberos ticket issuance.
postpatch_mutual_pair_flow.external_kerberos_notes: Must use getST.py, Rubeus, or equivalent. Exit code 0 is the only proof beyond LDAP state.

existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow._note: Validate all sub-scenarios before marking flow complete.
existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow.key_cred_only_notes: Grant only KeyCredentialLink; confirm no executable migration path appears.
existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow.gmsa_membership_only_notes: Grant only GroupMSAMembership; confirm no executable migration path appears.
existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow.preceded_by_only_notes: Grant only ManagedAccountPrecededByLink (not DelegatedMSAState); confirm path blocked.
existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow.both_attrs_notes: Grant both dMSA migration attrs plus both target-side attrs; confirm path appears.
existing_dmsa_postpatch_mutual_flow.ldap_verify_notes: LDAP-state verification does not prove Kerberos ticket issuance.

failure_and_rollback_validation.target_write_failure_notes: Force target-side modify failure after dMSA creation; verify operation enters partial-failed state.
failure_and_rollback_validation.maybe_created_dn_notes: Simulate add_object exception; verify maybe_created_dns recorded before the write.
failure_and_rollback_validation.rollback_partial_notes: Rollback must reverse all written steps and delete created dMSA.
failure_and_rollback_validation.stale_lock_notes: Simulate stale .lock file; verify cleanup proceeds without manual intervention.
failure_and_rollback_validation.external_verifier_notes: Run verify --mode external without --store-external-output; confirm only hashes stored in operation log.

kerberos_verification_boundary._note: Native Kerberos is not implemented. External verification only.
kerberos_verification_boundary.ldap_verify_note: CLI must print 'LDAP-state verification does not prove Kerberos ticket issuance.'
